title.narrative: GSD/UPB/Empowering Bishkek Stakeholders for Sustainable Development: Awareness and Capacity Building for SDG Action/

description.narrative:
From 2020-2022, UNECE collaborated with Bishkek’s Mayor’s Office to develop a Smart Sustainable City Profile, measuring the city's progress towards the SDGs using key performance indicators (KPIs) for smart and sustainable cities. This initiative supported the preparation of Voluntary Local Reviews (VLRs) on local SDG implementation. Since 2022, a joint project by UN-Habitat, UNDESA, UNECE, and UCLG has furthered this work in Bishkek, forming a working group to drive SDG implementation through VLR recommendations, focusing on access to services, digitalization, and public transport.
The Joint Programme (JP) aims to improve quality of life in Bishkek by addressing climate change, pollution, and urban services, building on the VLR findings. UNECE, UN-Habitat, and partners will implement action-oriented recommendations from the VLR, transforming them into policy actions that address gender and vulnerable groups. The JP also focuses on capacity-building for SDG localization, financing, and monitoring progress. Additionally, it promotes Bishkek's participation in global platforms such as the World Urban Forum and the Forum of Mayors.
Key expected achievements include developing a roadmap for VLR implementation, enhancing digital transformation, improving public transport, and addressing air quality through reduced coal use. Capacity-building workshops will empower local stakeholders and improve data governance, with a focus on gender equality and digital literacy. The programme aligns with SDG targets, contributing to sustainable urban recovery and elevating Bishkek’s role in international SDG efforts
